simpleJp: 7/2前後、マルティラへ向かう道でキャゼリナに勝つ
jpGuide1: イベント戦で勝利する
enGuide: Catherina R2: Her next bond is a mandatory Gauntlet Runner travel battle en route to Martira (around July 2). Win her encounter; there is no standard town dialogue to substitute.

simpleJp: 7/4前後の物語でハイザメを仲間にする
enGuide: Heismay R1: Progress through the Martira kidnapping/castle main-story chain and recruit him (around July 4–5); this automatically opens the Thief bond.

simpleJp: マルティラの主作戦を終えてバードンの支援ランク1を確認する
enGuide: Bardon R1: Story-unlocked after the Martira castle/captive-children resolution. Do not seek R2 yet: his follow-up returns after the July 23 story milestone.

simpleJp: 7/5の主作戦を終え、ガリカのランク3を確認する
enGuide: Gallica R3: Automatic after the Martira 'True Kidnapper' story operation clears, at or after July 5.

simpleJp: 説得力2を得て夜の鎧戦車でハイザメと話す
jpGuide1: 仲間のことを知りたい（説得力2）
enGuide: Heismay R2: After the Martira operation, get Eloquence (説得力) 2. Talk to Heismay in the Runner's central passage at night, outside a forced plot-travel lockout.

simpleJp: ハイザメのランク2から2日後、昼に中央通路で話す
enGuide: Heismay R3: On an eligible day, talk to him in the Runner's central corridor, daytime, two days after R2. Use a free slot on a town-stationary day when the icon appears.

simpleJp: ハイザメのランク3から2日後、夜に中央通路で話す
enGuide: Heismay R4: Talk in the central corridor at night, two days after R3. Save upcoming discretionary travel for his R5.

simpleJp: 任意の鎧戦車移動中、ハイザメと話す
enGuide: Heismay R5: Two days after R4, speak with Heismay during a discretionary Gauntlet Runner journey in daytime/on the deck. Do not assume forced story travel counts.

simpleJp: ランク4から2日後、昼のマルティラでストロールと話す
jpGuide1: マルティラの街道広場
enGuide: Strohl R5: After his travel-only R4, wait two days then talk to him in a town hub in the daytime (Martira's Thoroughfare Square is an early choice). Train Imagination to 3 for R6.

simpleJp: 想像力3でストロールの遺産探しを完了する
jpGuide1: ストロールの遺産探しを手伝え
enGuide: Strohl R6: With Imagination 3, accept/complete 'Help Strohl Search for His Inheritance' (ストロールの遺産探しを手伝え). Follow the quest directions in Grand Trad and report back before seeking R7; merely talking is not sufficient.

simpleJp: ヒュルケンベルグのランク3から2日後、マルティラの酒場で話す
enGuide: Hulkenberg R4: Daytime, Martira's Visca Alba tavern, two days after R3. Her following ranks are Gauntlet Runner travel scenes.

simpleJp: 任意の鎧戦車移動中、ヒュルケンベルグと話す
enGuide: Hulkenberg R5: Two days after R4, approach her on the deck during free Gauntlet Runner travel in the daytime.

simpleJp: 王都のマリアと話して支援ランク3にする
enGuide: Maria R3: Speak to Maria in Hushed Honeybee Inn during the daytime, around two days after her second bond. You do not have to collect landscape paintings for this bond.

simpleJp: 2日後、王都のマリアと話して支援ランク4にする
enGuide: Maria R4: Visit Maria again in the daytime after the ordinary rank cooldown. Her rank 4 perks include Speed Cooking; optional travel landscape pictures are not required.

simpleJp: さらに2日後、王都のマリアと話してランク5にする
enGuide: Maria R5: Grand Trad inn, daytime, approximately two days after R4. If you are away from Grand Trad, complete it at the next available return.

simpleJp: 勇気3を得て夜のベルギッタに報告する
enGuide: Brigitta R5: Once her R4 is completed, reach Courage (勇気) 3 and talk to her at Grand Trad Sunlumeo Street at night. A missing icon usually means the courage gate/cooldown is not satisfied.

simpleJp: ベルギッタのランク5から2日後、夜に話す
enGuide: Brigitta R6: Night at her Grand Trad shop area, at least two days after R5. Build Courage 4 for R7.

simpleJp: 勇気4を得て夜のベルギッタと話す
enGuide: Brigitta R7: Raise Courage 4 and speak with her at night in Grand Trad, two days after R6. Her final R8 has a separate September 26 availability gate.

simpleJp: 人喰い洞窟でニューラスの遺物を回収して渡す
jpGuide2: 遺物を知る人物を探せ
enGuide: Neuras relic #1 of 6: Visit Man-Eater's Grotto, obtain the screw-topped mineral (ネジのついた鉱物) and return it to Neuras in the Gauntlet Runner at night. This advances one rank among R2–R7; the six relics can be delivered in any order.

simpleJp: ディーラーをランク15まで育成しモアに報告する
jpGuide1: ディーラーを履修しRANK15まで鍛える。
enGuide: More R4: Study Merchant/Dealer (ディーラー), level that Archetype to rank 15, then report More's next Akademia task. This is separate from Brigitta's bond rank.

simpleJp: 15種類のアーキタイプを履修しモアに報告する
jpGuide1: 15種類のアーキタイプを履修する。
enGuide: More R5: Study at least 15 distinct Archetypes across party members and report the corresponding Akademia assignment. Count unique studied Archetypes, not levels within one class.

simpleJp: 7月中旬の鎧戦車移動でキャゼリナに勝つ
jpGuide1: イベント戦で勝利する
enGuide: Catherina R3: On the relevant travel leg from Martira toward Brilehaven (after the later July story transition), defeat Catherina in her second road challenge. This is an encounter, not an optional town evening scene.
